messages:
From: Amanda Hsu <amanda.hsu@ledgergrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@ledgergrid.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Request for temporary P1 bridging and delegation during maintenance

Hi Marissa —

We're planning a major data migration for LedgerGrid next weekend (12/11-12/12 US-west maintenance). Our platform will be partially degraded for a ~6 hour window each night for schema migration. Given the customer impact, Legal wants confirmation on how Redwood will handle P1 alerts during that window and whether we can accept a short-term delegation model for first-touch triage.

Specifically: 
- Can Redwood accept a temporary delegation where LedgerGrid's on-call triages and resolves <30% of incidents while Redwood guarantees ETA for second-level escalation?
- If delegation is approved, will Redwood provide written consent and a short SLO amendment (temporary) that documents the escalation path and any credit/credit-waiver terms?

We're under a hard freeze on contract language edits; a signed approval or DocuSign acceptance from Redwood will keep Legal happy. We can provide our on-call contact matrix and SLA playbook.

Appreciate a quick confirm — we need an operational decision this week to finalize the migration runbook.

Thanks,
Amanda
Senior Ops Manager
LedgerGrid
[Attachment: oncall_matrix_ledgergrid.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Request for temporary P1 bridging and delegation during maintenance

Amanda — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the matrix. Looping Ben and Laura to confirm operational details and provide the short SLO amendment you asked for.

High level proposal from Redwood (summary):
- Temporary delegation window: 12/11 22:00 PST -> 12/12 04:00 PST and 12/12 22:00 PST -> 12/13 04:00 PST (two nightly windows, up to 6 hours each).
- Delegation scope: LedgerGrid on-call accepts initial triage for P1s (acknowledge + basic triage). Redwood remains primary owner for full resolution and will accept escalations within 30 minutes of PagerDuty escalation.
- Escalation path: LedgerGrid ops -> PagerDuty escalation rule -> Redwood second-level on-call (Ben) -> Redwood SRE bridge if not resolved in 60 minutes.
- Credits/terms: Redwood proposes no automatic credits for the delegation period if Redwood SLA targets are met for escalations; if Redwood misses agreed escalation SLAs, pro-rated credits apply per the existing contract. We'll produce a short amendment (1 page) you can sign.

I've attached a draft one-pager SLO amendment and our suggested on-call matrix for the delegation. Please review and confirm the contacts for PagerDuty escalation (we need direct escalation IDs). If you can sign the DocuSign link by EOD Friday, we'll approve the operational change for the migration window.

Action items:
- Amanda: confirm PagerDuty escalation IDs and primary on-call name(s) (reply to this thread).
- Ben: please confirm that Redwood can guarantee 30-minute escalation ETA for the two windows and note any constraints.
- Laura: approve the final wording for the one-pager and check with Legal if any additional clause is needed for credits.

Attachments: SLO_ledgergrid_draft.pdf, oncall_matrix_ledgergrid.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLO_ledgergrid_draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Marissa / Amanda — quick operational note from the SRE side. We can accept the proposed escalation ETA (30-minute handoff to Redwood second-level) for the two nightly windows, with the following constraints and clarifications: 

- Constraints:
  * This is a strictly time-boxed exception limited to the two nights listed. Any extension requires 24h notice and explicit approval.
  * If the PagerDuty escalation is misconfigured (wrong escalation ID or no automatic escalation), the delegation is void; LedgerGrid must confirm and test escalation entries 24 hours prior.

- Operational clarifications (to be included in the one-pager):
  * Triage definition = acknowledge + initial mitigation (e.g., circuit breaker toggle, rolling restart) but not cross-team fixes that require infra changes.
  * Escalation payload must include full incident context: request ID, affected model/version, request samples (if privacy-permitted), and timestamp. Missing context will add time to triage SLAs.
  * Redwood will stand up a dedicated Slack channel (redwood-lg-migration) during the windows for rapid context handoffs.

If those are acceptable I'll sign off and Ben (SRE on-call) will be the 2nd-level on-call for the windows. Marissa — please add the DocuSign link and we'll get Legal sign-off on Redwood's side.

Ben Carter
Director, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference
